flows:
Navigate to https://www.colorhexa.com/ff0000 then Use Tab, Shift+Tab, arrow keys, Page Up, Page Down, Home, End, text entry, Space and Enter only.
Remain on this public site.
Stop before sign-in, registration or payment.
Never change fixture settings.
Use only visible controls.
Verify the final result on the page.
Open the color picker from the red swatch next to the search field.
Press Tab through at least three controls unless the swatch gets focus sooner.
If it gets focus, @v16:"press Enter".
Verify the color spectrum and hue slider appear.

verdict.root_cause: The automation incorrectly concluded that Tab skipped the swatch. Its own final observation says the red swatch got focus, but it did not perform the required Enter key action or check for the color controls afterward.
verdict.agent_fault_assessment: The agent caused the failed outcome by treating an intermediate focus state as a blocker. The objective explicitly instructs it to press Enter when the swatch gets focus; step 0-8 records that this condition was met, yet no Enter action or final page verification followed. There is no evidence that the site refused a correctly performed keyboard action.
